focus.headline: Stop the 6-hour loops
actions: Worst loop was 6.0h in Interior-Design — when 3 hours in and looping, stop. Restart with a written goal.
Set a personal 2-hour timer on hard debugging sessions before walking away.

do_i_know.label: Do I know what I'm doing?

broken_in_prod.caption: hotfixes within 24h of the commit they broke
broken_in_prod.examples_label: Hotfixes and the commits they patched
broken_in_prod.how_to_improve: The damning pattern: ship → site breaks → hotfix. Before merging, run the actual user flow once in preview. For auth/payments/data writes, do it in prod after the deploy lands.

uptime.how_to_improve: Slow TTFB usually means a cold serverless function or a DB call on every request. Cache reads at the edge, lazy-load non-critical data, and keep the homepage payload small.

mttf.caption: median hours bugs lived before patched

cron_health.caption: scheduled tasks firing on time (stale = >2× expected period)
cron_health.how_to_improve: Open the Scheduled sidebar and hit 'Run now' on each stale task to pre-approve its tools. Tasks hang at permission prompts when unattended. If the app is closed when a task is due, it queues until next launch — keep Claude Code open during expected firings.

fix_to_feature.caption: of commits start with 'fix'
fix_to_feature.how_to_improve: Write one more line of plan before each change. Run it locally or in a preview before merging. Pair commit msgs with 'feat:' when you're adding something — habitual 'fix:' framing skews the number.

debug_spiral.caption: longest single debug spiral, capped 6h
debug_spiral.how_to_improve: When you're 3 hours in and looping, stop. Walk away, then come back and write down what you're actually trying to do. Most 6h sessions would have been 1h with a fresh start.

test_coverage.caption: repos with any test file at all
test_coverage.how_to_improve: Pick the one repo you can't afford to break — your bread-and-butter. Write one happy-path test for the riskiest user flow. One real test beats six theoretical ones.

todos.caption: TODOs, FIXMEs, HACKs across the codebase
todos.how_to_improve: Half your TODOs are dead — written, forgotten, irrelevant. Once a month, walk through them: delete what no longer applies, turn what matters into a real task, leave only what's truly pending.

secrets_blocked.caption: secret-y patterns gitignored before they leaked
secrets_blocked.how_to_improve: Run `git-sync-fixer` to add a secret-safe .gitignore to every new repo. Already automated — but you can manually audit unprotected repos by adding .env, credentials.json, *.pem to their .gitignore.

reverts.caption: reverts and 'oops' commits
reverts.how_to_improve: Reverts mean a change shouldn't have landed. Read the diff before you push, even when you're sure. If you push 'just to try it in prod,' that's the move to cut.
